endorsements.name: Dario D. Diaz
endorsements.label: DMCA, Then and Now
endorsements.description: DMCA, Then and Now A look at the Digital Millenium Copyright Act (DMCA), what it was originally meant to do, what it's done, and how it's been used and abused. The highly misunderstood statute was hastily enacted and has been put to the test. While most in the hacker community might agree that the DMCA has been a failure, the actual legal results might actually provide some interesting insight. The lecture will involve an analysis of the statute, the legislative history, case law (both criminal and civil), and a perspective of the DMCA's future.
